body:
Dear Ahmed,

**RE: Delay Notice & Penalty Assessment — Order ST-2026-0847**

We write to formally notify you of a material delay in the delivery of Order ST-2026-0847 (Structural steel 150 tons), originally scheduled for April 5, 2026, and your estimated 2-week delay.

**Contract Reference:**
Our agreement specifies a maximum allowable delay of 7 days (Clause [Delay Provisions]). For each day beyond this threshold, a penalty of 0.5% of the order value ($340,000) shall apply.

**Delay Assessment:**
- Original Delivery Date: April 5, 2026
- Max Allowable Delay: April 12, 2026 (7 days)
- Current Status: Delayed approximately 14 days
- Exceeded Days: 7 days

**Penalty Calculation:**
- Daily Penalty Rate: 0.5% × $340,000 = $1,700/day
- Days in Violation: 7 days
- **Total Penalty Due: $11,900**

We request written confirmation of your revised delivery date and acknowledgment of the applicable penalty by **March 28, 2026**. Failure to respond may result in further remedies under the contract terms.

We value our partnership and trust this can be resolved promptly to avoid further impact on Project Alpha.

Regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
subject: Formal Notice — Contract Delay & Penalty Assessment | Order ST-2026-0847
